description: Sprint 6 features: PDF/ZIP export, auto-save session to IndexedDB, bubble search (Ctrl+F), and multi-select in sidebar for batch operations
steps: Install jspdf and jszip: npm install jspdf jszip

Create features/viewer/exportService.ts - Export translated pages as PDF or ZIP. Use jspdf for PDF and jszip for ZIP. Reuse renderToCanvas logic from features/viewer/downloadCanvas.ts. Sanitize filenames using [^a-zA-Z0-9_\-.] (NO backslash before dot - critical lint rule). Export functions: exportAsPDF(images, options) and exportAsZIP(images, options).
Add 'Exportar PDF' and 'Exportar ZIP' buttons in sidebar (App.tsx) - show only when history has at least one 'done' item. Place after the 'Traduzir Todas' button section.
Bump IndexedDB version from 2 to 3 in services/imageStorage.ts, add 'session' object store in the onupgradeneeded handler.

Create features/session/useSessionPersistence.ts hook - debounced auto-save of session state (currentImage id, history metadata) to IndexedDB 'session' store. On app load, restore session if found. Export a clearSession() function.
Add 'Limpar Sessao' button in sidebar footer (App.tsx) that calls clearSession().
Wire useSessionPersistence hook into App.tsx (call it at top level).

Create components/BubbleSearch.tsx - floating search panel triggered by Ctrl+F. Case-insensitive substring search across all pages' bubbles (both originalText and translatedText). Results list with page name + bubble text preview. Clicking a result navigates to that page and selects the bubble.
Wire BubbleSearch into App.tsx - render it, handle Ctrl+F to toggle visibility, provide navigation callback.

Add multi-select support in sidebar (App.tsx): Ctrl+Click on sidebar items adds/removes from selectedPages set. Selected items show checkbox overlay. When selection is active, show floating action bar with: translate selected, retranslate, delete, export ZIP.
Run npm run typecheck && npm run lint to verify zero errors
Commit with message: feat(sprint6): PDF/ZIP export, session persistence, bubble search, multi-select sidebar
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck passes with zero errors
npm run lint passes with zero errors (warnings OK)
npm run build produces dist/ successfully
exportService.ts exists and uses correct regex [^a-zA-Z0-9_\-.] (no useless escape)
IndexedDB version bumped to 3 with session store
findings: All verification passed: typecheck 0 errors, lint 0 errors (40 warnings pre-existing), build produces dist/ successfully. The handleRetranslate function takes no args so multi-select retranslate uses retryImage(id) instead. BubbleSearch navigates to the page but does not select a specific bubble (ProcessedImage has no editingBubbleId field).
